name: North Hyde substation fire, Heathrow closure
cause: Transformer bushing failure, moisture ingress; preventable fault known ~7 years earlier (NESO final report)

name: Google Cloud Service Control failure, with Cloudflare Workers KV knock-on
cause: Policy change inserted into regional Spanner tables triggered null-pointer crash loop in Service Control; no feature flag (Google incident report)

name: Google Cloud europe-west2-b power event
cause: Power event; secondary reporting says generators did not take over (PLC configuration) during maintenance that reduced resilience
cause_status: Confirmed (Google root-cause update of 4 Nov 2026, as reported by The Register)

name: Iberian Peninsula blackout
cause: Multiple interacting factors: voltage control, oscillations, cascading generation disconnections on overvoltage (ENTSO-E final report, 20 Mar 2026)
cause_status: Confirmed (expert panel final report); most individual trips unexplained

name: AWS us-east-1 DynamoDB DNS failure
cause: Latent race condition in DynamoDB DNS management automation left an empty regional endpoint record; cascaded to EC2 launches and NLB (AWS post-event summary)

name: Cloudflare Bot Management feature file outage
cause: Database permissions change duplicated rows in Bot Management feature file; doubled file exceeded proxy limit and crashed routing software (Cloudflare post-mortem). Initially suspected as DDoS.

name: Optus Triple Zero outage (firewall upgrade)
cause: Firewall upgrade blocked 000 call path; independent report found at least ten mistakes; 16th of 18 planned upgrades; incorrect instructions to Nokia
cause_status: Confirmed (independent report, per The Register; Senate estimates statement)

name: Telstra national mobile outage (time-sync defect)
cause: A planned maintenance job on Telstra's network timing system spread incorrect date information through parts of the mobile network; root issue was timing not treated as a critical function
cause_status: Confirmed (independent external investigation commissioned by Telstra)

name: Cloudflare WAF change outage
cause: Security-mitigation config change (WAF buffer, React CVE response) exposed a latent defect in FL1 proxy (Cloudflare post-mortem)

name: Azure Front Door configuration outage
cause: Configuration changes across two control-plane versions produced incompatible metadata that rolled out globally, then an asynchronous data-plane defect caused crashes (29 Oct). Customer-config trigger and manual override describe the separate 9 Oct AFD incident.

name: Starlink global network outage
cause: Failure of key internal software services running the core network (Starlink VP, per Telecoms Tech News); ThousandEyes: centralised control plane failure

name: North Macedonia voltage-instability blackout
cause: Low consumption and cross-border transit as probable cause of high voltage (MEPSO, per IEA)

name: Chile national grid separation
operator: ISA InterChile (500 kV line/substation operator, subsidiary of ISA)
cause: Inadvertent relay operation tripped the 500 kV backbone, cascaded, split grid into two islands (POWER)

name: US winter storm power outages
operator: Multiple US utilities; most outages in Tennessee, Mississippi and Louisiana (grid operators not named in sources)
cause: Extreme winter weather

name: Nigeria national grid collapses
cause: NISO attributed first collapse to multiple 330kV line trips and unit disconnections; no official cause for the 27 Jan collapse
cause_status: Operator data; cause not stated in sources read

name: Cuba national grid collapses (series)
cause: Fuel cut-off and obsolete generation; some collapses unexplained, one linked to transmission problem
cause_status: Disputed: Havana blames US oil blockade; US State Dept blames Cuban government; Cuba gave no technical cause for 16 Mar collapse

name: ECB T2 payment system outages
cause: Glitch linked to a recent software update

name: Mastercard network outage (scheduled update)
cause: Scheduled system update (Mastercard statement); detail not disclosed
cause_status: Company said scheduled update; detail unconfirmed

name: Microsoft 365 / Copilot outage (upgrade issue)
cause: Technical issue during an upgrade (Gulf News)

name: FAA air traffic control outage
cause: Communications failure; FAA cited a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers; no cyber indication

name: JPMorgan Chase and US bank outages
cause: Software bug in an on-premise hardware system; not cyber-related (Chase spokesperson)

name: UK card payment failures (match night)
cause: Power outage at a third-party payment processor disrupted authorisations across platforms it runs

name: CrowdStrike Falcon content update crash
cause: Template Type expected 20 input fields, update supplied 21; validator missed it (CrowdStrike RCA)

name: Optus nationwide outage
cause: Routine software upgrade; routing information from international peering network cascaded; routers disconnected (Optus); ACMA investigation report published Nov 2024

name: AT&T Mobility nationwide outage
cause: Network change with equipment configuration error; insufficient controls (FCC report)

name: NATS flight planning system failure
cause: Flight plan with duplicate waypoint names caused FPRSA-R to fail; primary and backup failed within seconds (CAA independent review, NATS report)

name: Brazil national blackout
cause: Improper protection trip of 500kV Quixadá II–Fortaleza II line; wind and solar plants' voltage control underperformed (ONS final report)

name: Red Sea submarine cable cuts (AAE-1, EIG, Seacom, TGN)
cause: Cables cut; US officials said the anchor of the Houthi-struck ship Rubymar likely severed three; Houthis denied

name: East Africa SEACOM and EASSy cable failures
cause: Both cables damaged off KwaZulu-Natal; likely an undersea event (TechCentral); cause not confirmed in sources read

name: DBS and Citibank Singapore outage (Equinix cooling)
cause: Cooling system fault during a planned upgrade (contractor signal shut chilled water valves, per Business Times via FinTech Futures); temperature rose; backup recovery failed within 4 hours

name: Cloudflare control plane outage (Flexential power failure)
cause: Utility power event and generator failures at Flexential Hillsboro; failover dependencies untested (Cloudflare post-mortem)

name: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp global outage
cause: Faulty configuration change on backbone routers withdrew BGP routes and DNS

name: Fastly global CDN outage
cause: Latent bug from 12 May deployment triggered by valid customer config change; 85% of network returned errors

name: AWS us-east-1 outage
cause: Automated capacity-scaling activity triggered surge on internal network; congestion also impaired monitoring

name: Rogers national outage
cause: Core IP network update deleted routing filter; all routes passed to routers

name: Southwest Airlines scheduling meltdown
cause: Winter storm trigger; crew-assignment system overwhelmed by close-in cancellations, manual recovery
cause_status: reported (executives and DOT order; operator disputes tech failure)

name: Texas winter storm Uri blackouts
cause: Extreme cold caused generation failures while demand surged; ERCOT forced rotating outages

name: Atlassian Cloud deletion incident
cause: Maintenance script run with wrong execution mode and wrong ID list deleted sites for ~400 customers

name: FAA NOTAM outage and national ground stop
cause: Contract personnel unintentionally deleted files while fixing sync between primary and backup databases

name: Google Cloud, G Suite and YouTube network congestion
cause: Configuration change meant for a few servers in one region applied to many servers across neighbouring regions; more than half of network capacity lost
cause_status: confirmed by operator (incident report and VP blog)

name: Cloudflare global outage (WAF regular expression)
cause: New WAF managed rule with a backtracking regular expression exhausted CPU on all HTTP/HTTPS cores worldwide

name: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp outage
cause: 'Server configuration change' per operator; no detail published

name: Venezuela nationwide blackouts
cause: Failure at Guri plant and transmission; government alleged sabotage or cyber attack; independent commentators cite old equipment, poor maintenance and a vegetation fire near lines
cause_status: disputed (government sabotage claim unproven; maintenance failure widely assessed)

name: CenturyLink/Level 3 backbone outage
cause: Flowspec announcement destabilised BGP in the backbone (inferred by Cloudflare and Catchpoint from routing data; operator RCA not retrieved)
cause_status: Operator status update attributed it to a bad Flowspec rule (per Cloudflare and Catchpoint); formal RCA not read

name: AWS Kinesis us-east-1 outage
cause: Capacity added to Kinesis front-end fleet pushed servers past an OS thread limit; shard-map caches failed; restart of whole fleet required

name: AWS S3 us-east-1 outage
cause: Operator input error in a playbook command removed more S3 servers than intended; restarts of index and placement subsystems took hours

name: British Airways global IT failure
cause: Loss of power at a UK data centre compounded by uncontrolled return of power; surge damaged infrastructure; human error reported
cause_status: operator account; investigation findings not fully retrieved

name: TSB core banking migration failure
cause: Big-bang migration of five million customers to a platform that was not stable or complete; inadequate testing. Board review: two data centres configured inconsistently
cause_status: independent report (Slaughter and May, commissioned by TSB); board disputes parts

name: Visa Europe card payment outage
cause: Rare partial failure of a switch in one of Visa's two data centres; failover delayed
cause_status: confirmed by operator (letter to UK Treasury Committee, via press)

name: Google authentication / User ID service outage
cause: Quota reduction on User ID storage after grace period; no alert fired

name: Azure AD authentication outage (Sep 2020)
cause: Latent code defect in Safe Deployment Process caused update to deploy straight to production

name: Nashville AT&T central office bombing
cause: Deliberate explosion damaged power and flooded backup generators

name: Azure AD authentication outage (Mar 2021)
cause: Key rotation: automation ignored 'retain' state and removed signing key

name: Cloudflare backbone configuration error
cause: Router configuration change in Atlanta leaked BGP routes into backbone

name: South Australia statewide blackout
cause: Storm (tornadoes) downed transmission lines; wind farm protection settings then tripped, losing Heywood interconnector and system collapsed

name: Delta Air Lines Atlanta data centre power failure
cause: Switchgear / UPS switch fault at Atlanta facility; some servers not on backup power
cause_status: disputed (Delta says power loss; Georgia Power says Delta equipment, no area outage)

name: CenturyLink nationwide fibre network outage (Dec 2018)
cause: Faulty network management card in Denver generated four malformed packets propagated to all nodes; lost visibility prolonged recovery

name: Telstra national mobile outage (21 May 2018)
cause: Telstra attributed it to a 4G software fault that pushed customers to 3G, which overloaded; a failsafe also failed
cause_status: confirmed (company statement) but early reports said hardware

name: British Airways and others, Amadeus Altea outage (Heathrow)
operator: Amadeus (supplier); British Airways and other airlines
cause: Amadeus blamed a recent configuration implementation load to its network environment; load sheet generation blocked
cause_status: partly confirmed (supplier confirmed outage, root cause not read)

name: British Airways check-in and departure systems disruption (Aug 2019)
cause: Two separate systems affected: online check-in and flight departures; cause not given in the source read

name: Gatwick Airport drone closure
cause: Repeated drone sightings near the runway led to closure; operator never identified
cause_status: confirmed (event); perpetrator unresolved (a couple arrested in error and released)

name: Telstra national mobile outage (9 Feb 2016)
cause: Telstra attributed it to an 'embarrassing human error'
cause_status: partly confirmed (company statement; detail not read)

name: Telstra national mobile outage (17 Mar 2016)
cause: Offshore connection issue affecting international roaming customers flowed on to local customers; waves of reconnections overwhelmed the network

name: Vodafone Australia national mobile outage (25 Sep 2016)
cause: Router issue (operator wording); 4G unavailable, 2G/3G congested

name: Amadeus Altea outage, Lufthansa and Air France boarding (Apr 2017)
cause: Amadeus confirmed technical issues in its Altea system; Air France attributed the problem to Amadeus
cause_status: confirmed (supplier and airline statements via press)

name: Amadeus Altea global check-in outage (Sep 2017)
operator: 125 airlines including Qantas, Lufthansa, Air France, Southwest
cause: Amadeus said a faulty switch during network maintenance triggered the failure of Altea
cause_status: partly confirmed (supplier confirmed recovery; root cause beyond 'network failure' not read)

name: Telstra Chatswood exchange fire
cause: Fire at the Chatswood exchange affected mobile and fixed services

name: Hurricane Maria and Puerto Rico grid collapse
cause: Category 4 hurricane landfall 20 Sep 2017 following Hurricane Irma on 6 Sep; grid effectively destroyed; PREPA was insolvent and had cancelled vegetation management before the storms

name: Optus major network outage (22 to 23 May 2019)
cause: Optus confirmed a 'major network outage' affecting international websites and gaming platforms; cause not disclosed

name: Great Britain power disruption (9 Aug 2019)
operator: National Grid ESO; Hornsea One (Orsted); Little Barford (RWE); UK Power Networks
cause: Lightning strike on a transmission line; Hornsea windfarm and Little Barford gas station both tripped almost simultaneously, losing 1,378MW and exceeding the reserve held; protection disconnected about 5% of demand
cause_status: confirmed (National Grid ESO technical report; Ofgem investigation)

name: Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay blackout (16 Jun 2019)
operator: Argentine Interconnection System operators; Edesur; Uruguay UTE
cause: Operational error: a Transener 500kV line was down for repairs and a bypass was used without updating the Automatic Generation Shutdown system, causing a cascade failure in about 30 seconds
cause_status: unresolved in sources read (Wikipedia summary cites operative error)

name: RBA clearing service outage, NPP and Osko instant payments (Oct 2022)
operator: Reserve Bank of Australia (NPP settlement service); ANZ, CBA, Westpac, NAB and others
cause: Operational error in planned change applied incorrect setting to virtual server software (RBA final report)

name: Commonwealth Bank nationwide outage (26 Jun 2023)
cause: Cause not stated in the source read

name: Commonwealth Bank overnight outage (12 Mar 2024)
cause: Cause not stated in the source read

name: Tokyo Stock Exchange arrowhead failure (1 Oct 2020)
cause: Hardware malfunction in the shared disk device (memory card) and automatic switchover to the backup did not work; investigation report published 30 Nov 2020

name: National Stock Exchange of India outage (24 Feb 2021)
cause: NSE attributed it to failover logic for a storage system, implemented by a vendor, that did not conform to the exchange's design; telecom links were initially blamed
cause_status: partly confirmed (NSE statement; initial attribution to telecom providers later revised)

name: Verizon nationwide mobile outage (14 Jan 2026)
cause: Verizon confirmed a 'software issue' and ruled out a bad actor; full review announced, details not published in sources read
cause_status: partly confirmed (company statement; no root-cause detail)

name: KDDI nationwide mobile outage (2 Jul 2022)
cause: Router incorrectly configured during maintenance of nationwide transmission equipment; a flood of location registration signals congested VoLTE nodes and the subscriber database
cause_status: confirmed (KDDI report; MIC serious accident report received 28 Jul 2022)

name: NTT Docomo nationwide mobile outage (14 Oct 2021)
cause: Switch of the IoT location-information server to new equipment failed (software specification gap); the rollback was mishandled and triggered a flood of location registration signals from IoT devices that exhausted signalling exchange resources shared with phones
cause_status: confirmed (MIC serious accident report summaries; Docomo briefing as reported by Mynavi)

name: South Korea NIRS data centre fire (26 Sep 2025)
cause: Lithium-ion battery fire in the uninterruptible power supply room, suspected to have started during battery maintenance
cause_status: partly confirmed (government briefings via press; investigation by fire agency and forensic service)

name: Ecuador drought-driven rolling blackouts (2024)
cause: about 70 percent of generation/demand
cause_status: confirmed (energy ministry statements via press); investigations of responsibility ongoing

name: Yucatan Peninsula blackout (26 Sep 2025)
cause: CFE reported trips on 230 kV and 400 kV transmission lines; the Energy Secretary said it occurred during maintenance work
cause_status: partly confirmed (CFE operating detail via press; formal probe announced)

name: Eskom stage 6 load shedding, South Africa (Feb 2023)
cause: Breakdowns at Arnot, Hendrina, Lethabo, Majuba and Camden power stations took more than half of capacity offline; Eskom said total grid collapse was an improbable scenario

name: Sri Lanka nationwide blackout (Mar 2016)
cause: Explosion and fire at a main distribution centre outside Colombo tripped the grid; minister said sabotage not ruled out

name: Sri Lanka nationwide blackout (Aug 2020)
cause: Transmission technical failure at Kerawalapitiya grid substation; cascading failure

name: NTT Docomo mobile data outages (17 and 20 Dec 2022)
cause: 17 Dec hardware fault, failover failed; 20 Dec change error (manual omitted step). Mixed row.

name: Rakuten Mobile large-scale failure (4 Sep 2022)
cause: Software defect exhausted log memory in data-centre switches; emergency-mode procedure inadequate

name: NTT East and NTT West FLET'S Hikari and Hikari Denwa failure (3 Apr 2023)
cause: Software glitch in subscriber-line equipment; 116 units of the same foreign-made device (press)

name: SoftBank fixed telephone failures (18 to 20 Nov 2023)
cause: Primary: subscriber database hardware fault; untested switchover exposed software defect; wrong part replaced. Mixed row.

name: RBA RITS file-transfer and low-value settlement outage (Jan 2026, expired certificate)
cause: Expired intermediate certificate on the database platform behind RITS applications; a replacement issued 17 May 2025 was never installed (RBA incident report)
